scope: Read-only frozen-state audit of Sentaurus BGN model selection, doping observability, OldSlotboom deltaEg, density reconstruction, and band-edge split
evaluation_order: C-1 effective model selection from sdevice log
C0 native donor and acceptor observability and input identity
C1 deltaEg from total, absolute-net, and maximum-species concentration conventions
C4 frozen target-node and target-edge values
C5 conduction and valence band split

doping_policy.m27: Use native doping.csv and independently exported DonorConcentration and AcceptorConcentration fields.
doping_policy.m29: Do not score C0 because donor and acceptor fields were omitted. Permit the M27 full input doping only after exact node-id and coordinate identity; label all such downstream use explicitly.

claim_policy: The sdevice solver log is authoritative for the effective BGN model; omission of an explicit model is not interpreted as BGN off.
Missing donor or acceptor observables are not replaced by zeros for a C0 score.
A Bennett/Wilson versus Vela OldSlotboom deltaEg difference is diagnostic, not a same-model parity score.
M29 terminal currents remain measured results, but an invalid BGN-off label invalidates the corresponding causal effect estimate.
No Sentaurus rerun, Vela solve, or production default change is part of M39.
